provider_query: MDN page for the Request.redirect property
answer:
**Primary page**

1. **Request: redirect property — MDN Web Docs**  
   https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Request/redirect  
   Read-only `Request.redirect` is a `RequestRedirect` value: `follow` (default), `error`, or `manual`. Available in Web Workers; widely available since March 2017. Spec: Fetch Standard. Last modified 20 Sep 2026. [web:0]

**Related results**

2. **MDN source (GitHub)** — `mdn/content` page for the same property: title, slug `Web/API/Request/redirect`, values, example, and “see also” links (Service Worker API, CORS, HTTP).  
   https://github.com/mdn/content/blob/main/files/en-us/web/api/request/redirect/index.md [web:1]

3. **Request interface — MDN** — Parent page; lists `Request.redirect` as read-only and describes it as the redirect mode (`follow`, `error`, or `manual`).  
   https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Request [web:9]

4. **Japanese MDN** — Same property page in Japanese (`follow` / `error` / `manual`, default `follow`).  
   https://developer.mozilla.org/ja/docs/Web/API/Request/redirect [web:3]

5. **French MDN** — Same property page in French.  
   https://developer.mozilla.org/fr/docs/Web/API/Request/redirect [web:7]

6. **Japanese Request interface — MDN** — Parent page in Japanese; documents `Request.redirect` the same way.  
   https://developer.mozilla.org/ja/docs/Web/API/Request [web:11]

7. **Korean Request interface — MDN** — Parent page in Korean; `Request.redirect` is one of `follow`, `error`, or `manual`.  
   https://developer.mozilla.org/ko/docs/Web/API/Request [web:12]

8. **Bun reference (points at MDN)** — `Request.redirect` as `readonly redirect: RequestRedirect`; notes default follow behavior and links MDN.  
   https://bun.com/reference/globals/Request/redirect [web:4]
